Provide project context and coding guidelines that AI should follow when generating code, answering questions, or reviewing changes.

## Guidelines

1. Don't generate unnecessary md or txt files, generate only which are very necessary
2. Don't just start the implementation, first understand the user problem, understand the user requirements, codebase and all related documents, files and then start implementing
3. Your solution should follow the coding standards, industry standard, best practices as DRY and KISS principles
